'''Darth Hoth Fun With Star Destroyers v3.0''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 10 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 SYCFA Hoth DS 2003 FunWithS 4785.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

thanks for the reviews, here's the new one.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

First Action: Use Mobilization Points combo to pull Rendili.

First Turn: activation-5, force in force pile-5. Deploy Rendili. Throw Mobilization Points combo for Something Special Planned For Them. Save Force.

Subsequent turns: try to find the weapons to take out the opponent's starships. If the opponent isn't playing much space, save the weapons and lose them to force drains.

Card Choices:

Inconsequential Losses-forfeit weapons to used pile for 3.

Crossfire-get some extra power

Intensify The Forward Batteries-subtract from opponent's power

Commander Merrejk-find my systems

Admiral Chiraneu-add to force drains Deflector Shield Generators (V)-protect my Star Destroyers

Firepower-get back the weapons if they happen to become lost

Rendili StarDrive-the basis of the deck. Adds 1 to each Turbolaser destiny and lets them deploy and fire for free

Precision Targeting-adds 1 to each weapon destiny and lets me search for my weapons

Something Special Planned For Them-very expensive to run from me

Flagship (V)-get my Admirals

Come With Me (V)-get my other pilots without wasting the once per game on Piett

Defensive Fire (V)-an extra shot

Imperial Artillary-nice 7 and makes opponent lose a force

Sniper combo-yet another extra shot

Dominator-good Victory-Class SD

Judicator-great for weapons

Victory-Class SDs-can be retrieved via Rendili

Heavy Turbolaser Battery-good at hitting things plus more power to my SDs

Laser Cannon Battery-can hit starfighters

Heavy Turbolaser Battery destiny against capital starships is +3 and -2 against starfighters with Rendili StarDrives and Precision Targeting out.

Laser Cannon Batteries are +1 with Precision Targeting out.

Thanks for looking, and, hopefully, reviewing. It was a little difficult to find what to take out, so any suggestions are apprectiated.

Thanks for the review, Shewski. Since I see MBO quite a bit, I think instead of going with the War Room, I'll go with the BF: Bridge, that way I don't have to lose extra force if the Death Star is blown away.
